overview:
Joe Courtney, a Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in Connecticut's 2nd District, which leans Democratic by about four points. His Republican challenger, George Austin, has raised under $300,000 and holds about $200,000 on hand, while Courtney has raised more than $760,000 and has a three-to-one cash advantage. No outside groups have targeted the race.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available, so the outlook rests on fundamentals: the district lean, incumbency, and the money gap. Prediction markets put Courtney's chances around 94 percent. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with a wide but not absolute margin reflecting the absence of direct polling.
